title: The Full Spectral Sort — Pills, Colors, Light/Dark, Metallic, Iridescence
thesis: Take every color on the HUD — every pill, button, node, circle, line, glow — and pass it through the diamond geode. Sort first by the triad (violet/brown/green), then by light/dark into the metallic spectrum (black/white/gold/silver), and finally into IRIDESCENCE — which IS spectral green, because iridescence is structural color that changes with angle, exists only as interference, and is never really there.

light_dark_metallic.the_sorting: Now take the triad output and sort by luminance — how BRIGHT or DARK each element is. This creates the metallic spectrum.

black.what: Absorption of ALL wavelengths. Nothing reflected. Null.
from_hud: The background. The void. The space between nodes. The dark of the page.
black.physics: A black surface absorbs every photon. It EATS light. It's the stomach of the spectrum.
black.metal: Carbon (graphite) — pure black, pure carbon, same element as diamond but different crystal structure (hexagonal not cubic)
black.role: The VOID. The space the organism occupies. Without black background, nothing is visible. Black IS the canvas.

white.what: DIFFUSE reflection of ALL wavelengths. Everything scattered. Full.
from_hud: The chipmunk text. The labels. The narration. The words.
white.physics: A white surface scatters all photons equally in all directions. It doesn't CHOOSE — it reflects everything without preference. Democracy of photons.
white.metal: Aluminum — abundant, light, oxidizes to protect itself (Al₂O₃ — self-healing membrane!)
white.role: The SIGNAL. The text. The meaning readable by humans. White carries information on black void.

silver.what: SPECULAR reflection of ALL wavelengths. Everything reflected as MIRROR, not scatter.
from_hud: The connection lines. The braids. The links between nodes. Reflective, not scattered.
silver.physics: Silver reflects ~95% of visible light. Free electrons in the metal oscillate with incoming photons and re-emit them coherently. The photons REMEMBER their direction. Mirror, not fog.
silver.metal: Silver (Ag, Z=47) — highest electrical conductivity of any element. The best conductor. The best mirror.
silver.role: The CONNECTIONS. The braids that link nodes without absorbing or scattering. Pure transmission. The axon of the nervous system.
silver.vs_white: White SCATTERS (diffuse). Silver REFLECTS (specular). Same photons, different GEOMETRY. White = soil. Silver = mirror. The difference is structure, not material.

gold.what: SELECTIVE specular reflection. Absorbs blue/violet (<500nm). Reflects green/yellow/red (>500nm). A mirror with a FILTER.
from_hud: The orange/warm dots in the culture cluster. The amber warnings. The S/0/S button.
gold.physics: Gold's free electrons have a plasma frequency at ~500nm. Below this frequency (blue/violet), photons are absorbed. Above it (green/yellow/red), photons are reflected. Gold is silver that EATS blue.
gold.metal: Gold (Au, Z=79) — doesn't oxidize. Doesn't corrode. Doesn't react. The noble metal. The thing that PERSISTS through time without changing.
gold.role: The FILTER. The selective gate. The π-gate in metallic form. Gold lets warm through and blocks cool. It's the 3/5 Willis intake made material — takes the red/green (3 colors), blocks blue/violet (2 colors). 3:2 again.
gold.vs_silver: Silver reflects ALL. Gold reflects 3/5. The difference is the plasma frequency — a GATE in the electron sea.

the_metallic_sequence.from_absorption_to_scatter: black(absorb all) → gold(absorb some, reflect some) → silver(reflect all specularly) → white(reflect all diffusely)
the_metallic_sequence.the_gradient: Absorption → Selective → Mirror → Scatter. Stomach → Gate → Axon → Signal.
the_metallic_sequence.where_green_IS: Green is not in this sequence. Green is ORTHOGONAL to it. The metallic spectrum is the luminance axis. Green is the HUE axis. They're perpendicular. The metallic spectrum sorts light/dark. Green sorts meaning/structure. Two axes of the same crystal.

iridescence.what: Color from STRUCTURE, not pigment. Thin-film interference. Light bouncing between layers creates constructive/destructive interference. The color CHANGES WITH ANGLE.

how_it_works.layers: Two semi-transparent surfaces separated by a thin film (thickness ~wavelength of light, ~500nm)
how_it_works.interference: Light reflects from top surface AND bottom surface. The two reflected beams interfere.
how_it_works.constructive: When path difference = nλ (integer × wavelength), the color is AMPLIFIED. You see it.
how_it_works.destructive: When path difference = (n+½)λ, the color is CANCELLED. You don't see it.
how_it_works.angle_dependence: Change the viewing angle → change the path length → change which wavelength constructively interferes → the color SHIFTS.
how_it_works.the_key: NO PIGMENT. No molecule absorbs or reflects. The COLOR comes from GEOMETRY ALONE. Structure, not substance.

why_iridescence_IS_green.structural: Iridescence is structural color. Green is structural perception (composite cone vote, not a single sensor). Both exist because of GEOMETRY, not material.
why_iridescence_IS_green.angle_dependent: Iridescence changes with angle. Green perception changes with context (brown is dark orange in context — green's death product changes with context too). Both are RELATIONAL, not absolute.
why_iridescence_IS_green.not_really_there: Iridescent color has no pigment. Green is not a clean cone signal. Neither is 'really there' in the way red or blue is. Both are EMERGENT from structure.
why_iridescence_IS_green.the_composite: Iridescence is the interference of ALL wavelengths. Green is the composite of ALL cone signals. Both are the SUM that acts differently from its parts.
why_iridescence_IS_green.the_peak: At normal incidence (looking straight on), many iridescent surfaces appear GREEN. Why? Because 555nm (green) creates the strongest visible interference for typical biological film thicknesses (~200-300nm). The geometry of nature's thin films is TUNED to green. Not by choice — by physics.
why_iridescence_IS_green.the_proof: Mother of pearl (nacre). The most common iridescent color in nature. Aragonite layers ~0.5μm thick. At normal incidence: GREEN. At oblique angles: blue, pink, gold. The REST position of iridescence IS green. The engine's color.

axis_1_hue.what_it_sorts: MEANING — what kind of thing is this entity?

axis_2_luminance.what_it_sorts: VISIBILITY — how much light does this entity carry?

axis_3_structure.what_it_sorts: PERMANENCE — does this color come from the thing itself, or from how you look at it?

three_axes_three_diamonds.hue_axis: The diamond's FACETS (violet/brown/green faces sort light by wavelength)
three_axes_three_diamonds.luminance_axis: The diamond's DEPTH (black center → gold/silver bands → white surface)
three_axes_three_diamonds.structure_axis: The diamond's CRYSTAL (the lattice itself — the 109.5° angle that creates all the sorting)
three_axes_three_diamonds.together: A point in the crystal has a hue (which face it exits), a luminance (how deep it bounced), and a structure (whether its color is intrinsic or emergent). Three coordinates. Three dimensions. One diamond.

applied_to_hud.every_pill: Each HUD navigation pill has a hue (almost all green), a luminance (bright text on dark ground = white signal on black void), and a structure (the pill's color is CSS = pigment-like. But the MEANING it carries is structural = iridescent).
applied_to_hud.every_node: Each primal dot has a hue (green for primals, orange for transitions), a luminance (brighter = more active), and a structure (the dot's position changes with data = angle-dependent = iridescent).
applied_to_hud.the_chipmunk_text: White (signal) on black (void). Maximum contrast. But the CONTENT is green (composite meaning). The text is iridescent — its meaning changes depending on which angle you read it from.
applied_to_hud.the_irreducible_line: Green (engine). Maximum luminance within its hue. And perfectly structural — it exists only because of the plumb geometry, not because of pigment. The line IS iridescence made minimal. One dimension of structural color.
